SELECT
    TRY_CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR)       AS product_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_name AS VARCHAR)     AS product_name,
    TRY_CAST(category AS VARCHAR)         AS category,
    TRY_CAST(standard_price AS DOUBLE)    AS standard_price
FROM read_csv_auto('C:\\Users\\lkdaryani\\OneDrive - Deloitte (O365D)\\Desktop\\IdamP\\data\\uploads\\products 2.csv', all_varchar => true);

SELECT
    transaction_id,
    TRY_CAST(transaction_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS transaction_date,
    store_id,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    TRY_CAST(quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity,
    TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DOUBLE) AS unit_price,
    TRY_CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE) AS total_amount,
    customer_segment,
    payment_method
FROM read_csv_auto(
    'C:\\Users\\lkdaryani\\OneDrive - Deloitte (O365D)\\Desktop\\IdamP\\data\\uploads\\sales_data 2.csv',
    all_varchar = true
);

SELECT
    TRY_CAST(transaction_id      AS VARCHAR)   AS transaction_id,
    TRY_CAST(transaction_date   AS TIMESTAMP) AS transaction_date,
    TRY_CAST(store_id           AS VARCHAR)   AS store_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_id         AS VARCHAR)   AS product_id,
    TRY_CAST(product_name       AS VARCHAR)   AS product_name,
    TRY_CAST(category           AS VARCHAR)   AS category,
    TRY_CAST(quantity           AS INTEGER)   AS quantity,
    TRY_CAST(unit_price         AS DOUBLE)    AS unit_price,
    TRY_CAST(total_amount       AS DOUBLE)    AS total_amount,
    TRY_CAST(customer_segment   AS VARCHAR)   AS customer_segment,
    TRY_CAST(payment_method     AS VARCHAR)   AS payment_method
FROM read_csv_auto(
    'C:\\Users\\lkdaryani\\OneDrive - Deloitte (O365D)\\Desktop\\IdamP\\data\\uploads\\sales_data 2.csv',
    all_varchar=true
);

SELECT DISTINCT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'elec%' THEN 'Electronics'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'apparel%' OR LOWER(category) LIKE 'cloth%' THEN 'Apparel'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'beauty%' OR LOWER(category) LIKE 'cosmetic%' THEN 'Beauty'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'sport%' THEN 'Sports'
        WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE 'home%' OR LOWER(category) LIKE 'kitchen%' THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
        ELSE category
    END AS category,
    standard_price,
    COALESCE(
        TRY_STRPTIME(_load_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d'),
        TRY_STRPTIME(_load_timestamp, '%m/%d/%Y')
    )::VARCHAR AS _load_timestamp,
    _source_file
FROM products_2_bronze_41d5d7cb
WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    s.store_id,
    AVG(s.total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM sales_data_2_silver_41d5d7cb AS s
LEFT JOIN stores_2_silver_41d5d7cb AS st
    ON s.store_id = st.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;
